legacy_adapter.calibration_boundary: Legacy CoreCo remains a synthetic top-down envelope. Its $30M unallocated goodwill is retained as a separately identified nonindustrial model balance, not independently substantiated acquired value.

core.tax_boundary: SHI is an LLC with unresolved tax classification. No entity-level income tax is imputed; owner taxes remain outside this explicit model.
core.deficit_policy: Finite member funding; when unavailable, identified Core operating payments are deferred and the scenario is infeasible. The model reports liabilities and shortfalls instead of posting invented financing.
core.opening_working_capital: Collect legacy operating receivables and settle legacy accounts payable and accrued operating liabilities in January2027; any unfunded operating payment remains a reported obligation.

shared_services.settlement: Accrue identified intercompany receivable/payable; quarterly settle only available legal-entity cash above the accepted $2M group floor. No external cost is added to consolidated Core support costs.
shared_services.authority: Derived planning cost-allocation agreement, not an executed historical invoice.
shared_services.tax_treatment: Book-only management allocation; no assumed income-tax deduction or recipient taxable-income uplift until legal tax characterization is established. Forecast operating-company tax is unchanged by this reporting charge.

opening_bridge.mine_historical_parent_basis: Recognize the accepted mine contributed capital through PS and SHIH with equal additional pre-2026 member contributed capital at SHI. The legacy engine omitted reciprocal industrial investments; this is a disclosed noncash opening reconstruction, not 2026 cash revenue or a recovered bank transfer.
opening_bridge.aru_2026: January 7 pushdown capital is the parent's net stock investment after acquisition financing and debt issuance contribution. Transaction expense remains separate. The cash-flow bridge separately presents external acquisition/refinancing flows.

holding_company_tax: No assumed tax consolidation election. SHIH acquisition expense and PS management-allocation losses generate no recognized deferred tax benefit; hypothetical tax losses are fully valuation-allowed in this bounded management model.
